method: Same infercnvpy-based compartment split (>=30 nuclei each side, 20 samples, 13,196 OPC-like nuclei) as the primary CHST11 contrast. Per-sample log1p(CP10k) mean difference (aneuploid - diploid); exact sign-flip permutation, two-sided. Cross-gene consistency: Spearman correlation of each gene's per-sample delta against CHST11's per-sample delta, across the 20 samples.
caveat: Descriptive pathway-consistency check, not a candidate-gene screen: no detection-matched null was applied to CSPG4/VCAN/BCAN/NCAN/ACAN (they were not drawn from a random background), and no multiple-testing correction was applied across the five genes. This does not measure chondroitin 4-O-sulfation directly (protein sulfation state) and does not replace mass-spectrometry-based disaccharide quantification (LC-MS/MS of chondroitinase-digested tissue).
